## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes, or any existing unrelated warning is documented
- [ ] Relevant desktop behavior was checked
- [ ] Relevant mobile/touch behavior was checked
- [ ] Scientific or factual changes cite a primary source
- [ ] No credentials, environment files, or personal data are included
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behavior or deployment changed

## Deployment

- [ ] No production deployment is needed
- [ ] Publish the merged commit through the existing Sites project
